gootex_core_notes: v8: WorPT tab — the 'preview' link now draws a live picture of your own table (click to view in an overlay) instead of opening a static screenshot. To update: Extensions → Apps Script → Libraries → GooTeX_Core_Library → select version 8 → Save. v7: Check System Status shows each Doc's hidden mark (and whether the template is marked); clearer message when GOOTEX_TEMPLATE_URL is not set. v6: gooTeX only works in Docs started from your group's template (copies of papers are refused).
gootex_thin_client_notes: Replace Code.gs and Config.gs in your thin client with the latest version from GitHub
